He was always on the lookout for trouble, but tonight, trouble found him in the form of a familiar figure.

Black Cat, the alluring and enigmatic anti-heroine, appeared out of the shadows, her silver hair shimmering in the moonlight. She wore her signature black leather suit, which hugged her curves in all the right places. A mischievous smile played on her lips as she approached Spider-Man.

"Well, well, if it isn't my favorite web-slinger," she purred, her voice dripping with seduction. "Fancy meeting you here."

Spider-Man, never one to back down from a witty exchange, quipped, "Black Cat, you have a knack for showing up when I least expect it. What's the plan this time? Stealing jewels or just trying to steal my heart?"

She laughed, a rich, throaty sound that sent shivers down his spine. "Oh, Spider, you know me too well. But tonight, I have something a little more... intimate in mind."

Before he could react, Black Cat leaped at him, wrapping her legs around his waist and pulling him into a tight embrace. Her thighs, strong and toned from years of acrobatics, squeezed his neck, cutting off his air supply. Spider-Man struggled, his spider-strength no match for her vice-like grip.

"What's the matter, Spider?" she teased, her face inches from his. "Can't handle a little squeeze?"

He gasped for air, his vision starting to blur. "Black Cat, this isn't funny. You're going to-"

"Shh," she hushed him, her lips brushing against his ear. "Just relax and enjoy the ride."

Spider-Man's struggles became weaker as she continued to tighten her hold. His senses were overwhelmed by her scent, a mix of leather and something uniquely her. He felt himself slipping away, his consciousness fading.

"That's it, Spider," she whispered, her voice a seductive lullaby. "Let go. I've got you."

As he teetered on the edge of unconsciousness, he heard her laugh, a sound both thrilling and terrifying. And then, there was only darkness.

When Spider-Man awoke, he found himself alone on the rooftop, the only evidence of Black Cat's presence a single silver hair left behind. He rubbed his neck, still feeling the phantom pressure of her thighs. With a shake of his head, he swung off into the night, knowing that their dance was far from over.
